Historical intermediate-tree observations only: the closure/image identities and
345/345 root-test count below predate the final PR tree and do not identify a
committed closure. They are superseded for PR #156 by the final image table and
346-test observations in the parent
[`01a08ff0-0b99-7315-99b0-7e7f340fa6f9`](01a08ff0-0b99-7315-99b0-7e7f340fa6f9.md).
Neither record is evidence for subsequent review-fix binaries.

Observed on the AArch64 seL4 `qemu-arm-virt` target, generation 54, from the
working tree based on `31fc559f6ef1061ac071f03dc2ac0e1c496de19f`:

- System-image closure:
  `aa5b1dee2277cc057f4e27b51e8023c03614bb95c23869cad30047569a119cf1`.
- Booted image SHA-256:
  `75f47d478fb61d16247fb502037d5cb7c01f19b61e514d9d5ff4c600abfc2322`.
- Generation SHA-256:
  `fc55015524931e0dddae881a1fe0dcd3e9ebdc2951d6c8c724a9926284790183`.

`just io_tcp_check` and the TCP arm of `just io_network_check` each observed a
real handshake, 4096 application bytes echoed byte-for-byte, partial writes,
FIN closure, peer reset refusal on declared port 4243, and undeclared address
and port refusals. The external peer independently reconstructed both streams
from checksum-validated TCP packets and observed all 4096 bytes acknowledged,
zero malformed frames, no forbidden egress, the declared ARP response, and all
five exact ICMP replies. One bounded retransmission recovered an unacknowledged
echo segment; transmitted bytes were never replaced by a fixture-only result.
All five required components completed and generation 54 ended healthy.

The service released both service-owned application buffers and had no live
application connection handles at shutdown. The separate nontransferable
control and transferable provisioning endpoints retain per-holder authority;
the intruder's exact-destination and independent-right refusals remained valid
without forbidden network traffic. TIME-WAIT pool state is not counted as a
live application handle and is retained until expiry or service exit.

Passed verification:

- `just io_tcp_check`, `just io_network_check`, `just io_link_check`, and
  `just link_peer_check`.
- `just sel4_gate_control_check`: 3005 marker/layout mutations refused across
  45 gates plus nine adaptive arms, with image/runtime negative controls.
  Peer controls additionally reject missing or altered bytes, incomplete
  handshake/close evidence, forbidden endpoints, runts and observer failure.
- `just contracts_check`, `just generation_check`; the latter observed two
  isolated byte-identical generation/boot-store builds.
- `just test_host`, `just test_sel4_root` (345/345), and `just io_tcp_host_check`
  (five production-engine tests against real smoltcp peers). Seven network
  protocol tests cover payload authority/bounds and malformed/valid request-ID
  reuse without a second terminal completion.
- `just fmt_check_all`, `just lint_all`, `just docs_check`, `just ruff`, and
  `just typos`. The owning system-spec checker passed 58 systems and 62 named
  mutation controls plus 18 computed-source controls without rewriting its
  historical baselines.

Scope is one external virtio-net TCP-client backend under QEMU. No physical NIC,
UDP/DNS, listener/accept, local TCP, general client bindings, wait-set, or
interrupted-request/client-death/service-restart reclamation is claimed.
Adapter timeout/drop alone can leave service-owned session resources live;
normal completion uses explicit teardown. Passive-close success is local handle
disposal, not proof of remote graceful delivery. The observed active close is
independently qualified by the peer's FIN/ACK evidence. These limits remain
owned by the follow-on listener/lifetime item and the current network docs.

### PR #156 review-fix revalidation

Directly observed on AArch64 seL4 `qemu-arm-virt` from the uncommitted review-fix
working tree based on `1d85440` (the identities below, not that base commit alone,
identify the tested binary):

- External TCP closure:
  `e13177ec4415ee2543313a68c7b5525aa2fb5834d4782aecef293876d9edc81f`.
- Booted external TCP image SHA-256:
  `7db1e38fe62b6db16d40b96011d53413223ba91908a5783babab85cdc105df04`.
- `just io_network_check` passed all six arms. Its external peer reconstructed
  4096 bytes in each direction, all 4096 echoed bytes acknowledged, handshake and
  FIN closure, one retransmission, zero malformed frames, refused-port reset and
  the declared ARP/ICMP replies. Guessed-handle refusals are not represented as
  application cross-holder runtime coverage.
- `just test_host` included 17 production TCP-engine tests, five actual-adapter
  host regressions and eight network protocol tests; `just test_sel4_root`
  passed 346/346. `just io_link_check` and `just link_peer_check` also passed.

These observations replace neither the historical bytes above nor their recorded
counts. They qualify the named review-fix QEMU image, not physical networking.
